name: Spaceflight News API
tagline: Free public API for spaceflight news, blogs, reports, and launches
description: The Spaceflight News API (SNAPI) is a free, public REST API that aggregates spaceflight news articles, blogs, and reports from major space-related publishers. It provides paginated JSON endpoints for articles, blogs, reports, and related metadata, and is commonly used by space apps, dashboards, and educational projects. No authentication is required for standard access.

auth.details: No authentication required for public read endpoints. Requests are made without API keys or OAuth.

use_cases: search space news by title or summary keywords
fetch space blogs and ISS-related reports
power a space news feed or dashboard
filter articles by news site or publication date
